prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Andorra
Primary request: The Madriu-Perafita-Claror Valley in the high Pyrenees, a beautiful glacial mountain valley with pastoral heritage.
Subject: A clear rocky mountain river flowing through green meadow and pine forests beneath craggy grey mountain slopes; one small traditional rough-stone pastoral shelter with a low stone roof beside a simple stone footpath.
Scene/backdrop: A believable broad U-shaped Pyrenean valley, wooded lower slopes and open high pastures, a little distant snow only on the highest peaks, blue sky.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Center the shelter, river bend and main mountain valley safely within the central 75% of width and height. Wide scenic view with generous breathing room for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, calm and inviting.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No city, castles, giant resort, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected original PNG. U-shaped glacial mountain valley, pines, meadow, rocky river and low stone-roof pastoral shelter. Shelter and central valley comfortably framed; outer mountains/river continue to edges. Cheerful brush-textured gouache style. No city/castles/text/UI/flags/logos or unrelated landmark.
